submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on running Continental Germanic text (German strongest, sustained ~0.5-0.7 of max; Dutch/Scandinavian moderate) via distributed subword cues integrated over roughly a clause, with French partially cross-activating (sustained ~0.2-0.3 of max). In otherwise-English text it stays near zero except for isolated spikes on dense unfamiliar Germanic fragments — German quotes, Dutch/German names, fragmented proper nouns after enumerative buildup — and crests on formal purpose-'to' after 'was'/'writing'; everyday English, Spanish and Italian stay near zero, and scrambling German word order does not reduce firing.
